description: Source code for defining a CodeMirror mode for the TTCN language, including tokenization rules, syntax highlighting, and mode registration.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents a parsing context for indentation and scope management within the mode.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Handles tokenization of basic language elements such as keywords, operators, strings, comments, and identifiers.

methods.name: tokenString
methods.description: Handles tokenization of string literals, including escape sequences and multi-line strings.

methods.name: pushContext
methods.description: Pushes a new parsing context onto the context stack.

methods.name: popContext
methods.description: Pops the current parsing context from the context stack.

methods.name: startState
methods.description: Initializes the tokenizer state for a new line.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Main tokenization function called by CodeMirror to process the stream.
